clicks: Open the **Recording plan** link above.
Read slides 1–4 (where everything happens; what is not built yet: never film those).
Skim slides 5–14 (the demo branch, its classes, bell times and groups).
Read slides 15–17 (who signs in where; practical rules) and slides 20–23 (how time passes).
p1.check: You know which features are not built, and which Chrome profile belongs to whom.

a1.before: Done in GitHub, not on the test site. It wipes the whole test database (about 10 minutes).
clicks: Open `github.com/sodiqschoolapp/sodiq-platform` and click the **Actions** tab.
In the left list, click **CI**, and check that the newest run on `main` has a green **deploy-test**. If one is still running, wait for it.
In the left list, click **Demo data on the test environment**.
On the right, click **Run workflow**; leave **Branch: main**.
In **The password of every demo account (10 characters or more)**, type a password you will remember (every seeded account uses it).
In **Type REPLACE to erase the test database and load the demo**, type `REPLACE`.
Click the green **Run workflow** button.
Wait until the run shows a green tick (about 10 minutes), then open it and scroll to its **Summary**.
Copy the table of logins from the Summary into a note: the Super Admin, the Demo Yunusobod AVP, the Senior Head Teacher and the 0 London Class teacher.
a1.check: The run is green and you have the seeded logins; the test site shows Demo Yunusobod and Demo Chilonzor.

clicks: On your phone, install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
Keep it at hand: the seeded Super Admin (step 2.1), Nodira the AVP (step 2.9) and the Demo Yunusobod AVP (step 3.15) each add one entry at their first sign-in by scanning the code the platform shows.
Name the entries `Sodiq SA`, `Sodiq AVP` and `Sodiq Yunusobod AVP` in the app, so you pick the right code on camera.
Save each set of recovery codes the platform shows in your note.
a2.check: The app is installed; it gets its three entries during Sessions 2 and 3.

a3.before: One Chrome profile per person on camera. In Chrome, the profile picture is at the top right of the window.
clicks: Click the profile picture at the top right of Chrome, then **Add** (or **Add Chrome profile**).
Click **Continue without an account**.
Type the profile name, for example `SA`, pick a colour, and click **Done**.

Repeat for `AVP`, `Teacher`, `Tutor`, `Class teacher`, `Head Teacher`, `Senior HT`, `Principal`, `Spiritual VP`, `Head Tutor`, `Yunusobod AVP`, `Spare 1`, `Spare 2` (for the rehearsal, `SA`, `AVP`, `Principal` and `Yunusobod AVP` are enough).
In each profile, open `chrome://password-manager/settings` and turn off **Offer to save passwords**.
In each profile, press `Ctrl+Shift+B` to hide the bookmarks bar, and stay signed out of Google (no sync).
In each profile, open the test site and bookmark nothing; keep this guide open in another window.
a3.check: Each person has their own Chrome window with its name and colour in the corner.

clicks: In your calendar, mark **Week 0**: a Thursday and the Friday after it (Sessions 2–4).
Mark **Week 1**: the next Monday to Friday (Sessions 5–6).
Check that both weeks fall in quarter 2 (9 November–26 December 2026) and not on 8 December.
Do every step of Sessions 2, 3 and 4 below in order, without recording.
Keep a note open; whenever the screen shows a different button, word or answer than this page or a deck, write down the step number and what you saw (a screenshot helps).
Send the note to Claude when you finish.
r1.check: The whole build worked once, and you have a list of differences.

clicks: Run step 0.2 again (the demo workflow with `REPLACE`): it deletes the rehearsal branch.
On this page, click **Clear ticks** at the top.
Start the real take at step 2.1.
r2.check: The test site again shows only the seeded branches; no ticks on this page.

clicks: Open the deck of the role whose takes you are cutting.
For each slide in the deck's order, find its take and cut it to a clip.
Name each clip `<role> <slide number> <slide title>`, for example `Teacher 11 Take attendance`.
Group the clips by the deck's dividers (the chapter slides).
s9a.check: One clip per slide, in deck order, for every role.
